meta_description: CGM Bathrooms and Plumbing offer expert plumbing and bathroom fitting across Nottingham. Reliable, fairly priced, and locally trusted. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured — Free Quotes — Nottingham Based
hero_subhead: Leaks, bathroom installations, or urgent repairs — CGM respond fast and get it right first time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Bathroom Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From a dripping tap to a full bathroom transformation, CGM Bathrooms and Plumbing cover every job with skill and care.

services.title: Full Bathroom Installations
services.desc: We design and fit complete bathrooms from scratch, handling everything from tiling and plastering to plumbing and electrics coordination. You get a stunning, fully finished bathroom without the hassle of managing multiple trades.

services.title: Bathroom Refurbishments
services.desc: Breathe new life into a tired bathroom with a professional refurbishment from CGM. We replace suites, update tiling, and refresh fixtures to give your space a modern, high-quality finish.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, sudden leaks, and failed stop valves can cause serious damage fast — we respond quickly across Nottingham to minimise disruption and protect your home.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Services
services.desc: We service, repair, and advise on boiler issues to keep your heating running efficiently throughout the year. Our team works on all major boiler brands and heating system types.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can silently damage floors, walls, and ceilings before you even notice them. CGM use proven diagnostic techniques to locate and fix leaks quickly, saving you money on water bills and repair costs.

services.title: General Plumbing Maintenance
services.desc: From replacing taps and toilets to fixing slow-draining sinks and running cisterns, we handle all routine plumbing tasks efficiently. Regular maintenance keeps small problems from becoming expensive ones.

about_pullquote: Every job matters — we treat your home with the respect it deserves.
about_para_1: CGM Bathrooms and Plumbing was founded right here in Nottingham with a simple aim: to provide homeowners with a plumber they can genuinely trust. Over the years we've built a strong local reputation by combining quality workmanship with honest, upfront pricing and no hidden charges.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is the personal service — when you call CGM, you speak directly with an experienced tradesperson, not a call centre. We take pride in leaving every home tidy, completing every job to a high standard, and making sure our customers are completely satisfied before we leave.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About CGM

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. CGM fitted our new bathroom and the quality is outstanding. Turned up on time every day, kept everything tidy, and finished within budget. Couldn't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Called CGM after a pipe burst under our kitchen sink. They were with us the same afternoon, sorted the problem quickly, and didn't charge the earth. Really decent, honest tradesmen — we'll be using them for our bathroom next year too.
reviews.author: Mark R.

reviews.text: Had CGM replace our old bathroom suite and re-tile the walls. The transformation is incredible — it looks like a completely different room. Very professional, great attention to detail, and the pricing was very fair. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Lisa B.
